review: I've been an avid fan of fifa games ever since I was a kid. I've been playing ever since fifa 14. To this day, I still think that 14 was the best I've ever played. Somehow it seems like fifa games have been getting worse over the years. Normally, as a company, you aim to make a sequel of a game to be better than the last one. But for EA, it's most definitely the opposite. For some reason, it seems like the developers at EA have gotten more retarded over the years. How is it possible to make a game this demoralising. Ranging from the poor ranking system, to the immense amounts of lag and glitches, even to (I can't believe I'm saying this) "scripting". HOW TF IS IT EVEN POSSIBLE TO ADD SCRIPTING TO A SPORTS GAME?!?! To then call it "momentum"?!?! No, it's pure bullshit. Doesn't mean that the difficulty is on Legendary that a Bronze player gets an insane stat boost and is immediately better than a TOTY. Don't tell me a 63 OVR defender with 60 pace, outruns my 93 bale with 92 pace, just because of "momentum". That's how you make your game better???? To be honest, that's how you lose your player base. Because of little brain rotting little things like that. Also, don't even get me started on the packing system. How am I gonna open multiple packs and get absolute dogshit. But then, my friend that sucks and never touched a fifa game in his whole existence, packs a TOTY on his first pack. I wanna also add that the online mode is fucking garbage. I would rather inhale insane amounts of nuclear radiation and eat toxic waste for the rest of my life than play in an online match with input lag and ACTUAL LAG. To be clear, on every other game, I average 11 ping but for some extraordinary reason, EA decides to slap me with on average 84 ping every fucking match. This whole game is unplayable, unreasonable, unmanageable and especially TRASH. Yet, I come back to it after every time I said I would never touch a game this bad, because of nostalgia and because I wanna relive my childhood of me playing fifa games. If the next game is this bad, I will never touch another EA game, because it will give me a hint that the game will already be completely atrocious. To conclude, I wouldn't recommend this to no-one, even my dead grandfather. SO, EA FIX UR SHIT OR YOU'RE GONNA LOSE A LOT OF PLAYERS.
